title: ExtractResult
description: How an Extract ended. Documents committed before it stay committed.

oneOf.description: Every document reached a final state.
`limits.max_usd` was reached; documents without a `document` event weren't finished.
The load's marker records another ontology version: nothing was written.
The graph holds no such load, or it is being deleted: nothing was written.

Building an index over data the graph already holds outlasted `helix.timeout_secs`:
nothing was written. Retry; the attempt doesn't count.

label.description: The node or edge label whose index was still building.

oneOf.description: The call was cancelled; the commit in flight finished first.

A commit may or may not have landed. Retry the same request once the store has
settled: it finds the document if it did.
Reading or writing the store failed, and nothing was left in doubt.

DocumentCounts.description: What one document put in the graph, or would have.

attribute_reviews.description: Property values the verifier was unsure of, written as reviews.

attributes.description: Property values it stated that were written as evidence.

attributes_over_entries.description: Accepted property values left out because its write had no room for them.

created.description: Entities it created, as its routes let it.

entities.description: Entities it names that resolved to the graph's.

identifiers_unverified.description:
Identifiers it gave entities that the verifier didn't accept, or that its text doesn't
write: none resolved an entity.

prop_conflicts.description:
Properties whose evidence now disagrees, with each other or with a row's value: each a
review.

rejected.description: Facts the verifier rejected, kept only in the artifact.

resolved.description: How its entities resolved, by rung.

unresolved.description: Names that resolved to no entity, or to several.

ExtractTotals.description: The sums of one Extract's `document` events.

counts.description: What they put in the graph.

duplicate.description: Documents whose text the graph holds under another id.

out_of_scope.description: Documents stored unread: no route reads their set.

stale_decisions.description:
Settled decisions that no longer fit the run's ontology version, which they outlived:
their type or property is gone, the property is now part of the key, the type's
identity doesn't read their `entity_key`, or their value isn't of the property's type.
They are left out, except a resolve decision whose type remains: its name is reviewed
again rather than matched another way.

swept.description:
Entities the documents created, or whose properties or facts they changed, swept for
violations once every document had reached its end: those of every document of the
load no sweep had checked, this run's and those an earlier run that stopped early
committed.

unchecked.description:
Of those, entities whose violations needed more reading than the sweep's budget: their
records are as they were.

usd_micros.description: The cost, in millionths of a US dollar.

ResolvedCounts.description: How many of a document's entities each rung of the resolution ladder resolved.

adjudicated.description: Linked by independently verified adjudication, when explicitly enabled.

alias.description: By another of its names, its fullest naming none.

identifier.description: By an identifier the verifier accepted, that a row gave one stored entity.

user.description: Linked by a settled resolve decision.
